snippet.title: DEATHTOUCH - Official Trailer (2025)
snippet.description:
Super pumped (and honestly a bit nervous) to finally show you the official trailer for my first ever game — DEATHTOUCH.

I’ve been working on this solo for the last two years, learning Unreal Engine from scratch, and it’s finally coming out THIS DECEMBER!!!

It’s a first-person atmospheric horror game — dark, creepy, and full of weird secrets and scary encounters. If you like games that mess with your head and make you jump a bit, this one’s for you.

Wishlist DEATHTOUCH on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3641270/Deathtouch/

I’ve put my heart into this one and can’t wait for you to play it. Thanks heaps to everyone who’s followed along, tested stuff, or just been keen for updates. You all keep me going.

Got questions? Ask me live: https://www.twitch.tv/richopov

Cheers for checking it out — Feel free to wishlist it if you dig it. It would mean the absolute world.

#DEATHTOUCH #IndieGame #HorrorGame #WishlistOnSteam #UnrealEngine5 #RichoPOV
